In the Undercroft, whoever stands lower on screen is now drawn in front, so he stands behind a pillager who is below him and in front of one who is above him. It shipped as v36.96 and is on his PC (`ON HIS PC v36.96`); he reloads to play it.

- **The fix:** crowd pillagers now go into the same sorted draw list as the walls, posts, party and him, keyed on their feet position. The separate "behind him" crowd pass is gone. Name tags and speech still draw on top. This is the same rule the raid already uses.
- **Check:** a pillager 20 px lower than him is drawn after him, and one 20 px higher is drawn before him. It failed on v36.55, and the ship gate passed it. The seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).
- **Picture:** I took an Undercroft shot (`tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/00a-245-after/03-hub-floor-1080.jpg`). The floor draws normally, and in the overlapping crowd pairs the lower pillager covers the upper one. I did not stage him above and below a crowd pillager, because the check covers that case. I did not run the critic, since the layout did not change.
- **What he should watch for:** in the Undercroft, whoever stands in front is drawn in front. Walk past the huddles and the dropped crates and see that nothing flickers or pops in front of something it shouldn't.
